default.text: Your reference number is included in the confirmation email we sent you.

summary.description: Text label describing the supporting content. Always escaped.

text.description: Plain-text content. Always escaped; line breaks and indentation are preserved, and long lines wrap. Ignored when children is supplied.

children.description: Composed content. Takes precedence over text when supplied, including an empty string.

open.description: Whether the native disclosure is initially open.

markerColor.description: USX color utility name for the summary marker, such as primary. Adds marker-{value} to the summary.

underlineColor.description: USWDS color utility name for the summary underline, such as secondary. Adds border-{value} to the summary text span.

contentBorderColor.description: USWDS color utility name for the content border, such as accent-cool. Adds border-{value} to the content unless noContentBorder is true.

noContentBorder.description: Whether to remove the content border.

noSummaryUnderline.description: Whether to remove the summary underline.

className.description: Additional CSS classes for the details element, including font and spacing utilities.

summaryClassName.description: Additional CSS classes for the summary element, including font and spacing utilities.

summaryTextClassName.description: Additional CSS classes for the summary text span, including font and spacing utilities.

contentClassName.description: Additional CSS classes for the content element, including font and spacing utilities.
